title: Empty Prototype Case
summary: The Argus-7 case, found open and empty on the shelf.
details: Foam-lined transit case, catalogue no. AR7-C. Latches undamaged. The foam cut-out is intact and undisturbed, as though the unit was lifted out carefully by someone who knew how it seated. Found by Dr. Voss at 07:30 Saturday.

title: Storage Room Door Report
summary: No forced entry. Door opened only by a valid magnetic card.
details: Locksmith's inspection of the Storage Room B door. Strike plate, deadbolt and hinges undamaged. The magnetic-card reader shows no tampering. Conclusion: the door was opened with a valid card. The reader keeps a log of every card used.

title: Lobby Turnstile Log
summary: Card exits from the lobby turnstile, Friday evening.
details:
Printout of the lobby turnstile for Friday 9 March, 19:00 to 23:00.

19:34  OUT  Voss, M.  (card 0217)
21:00  OUT  Reyes, A.  (card 0331)

No further entries or exits through the turnstile after 21:00.

title: Lobby Camera Still, 21:00
summary: Still frame of Alex Reyes leaving through the lobby.
details: Frame pulled from the lobby camera tape at 21:00. Reyes is seen leaving, jacket on, carrying a large canvas duffel bag that hangs loosely and looks empty. The night desk behind him is occupied.

title: Storage Room Recorder Timer Log
summary: The Storage Room camera recorded nothing for thirty minutes.
details:
Timer log from the CCTV recorder for Storage Room B.

21:10  Recorder switched to SERVICE MODE (remote)
21:40  Recorder returned to RECORD

The tape for the intervening thirty minutes is blank. Service mode is normally used only for scheduled maintenance.

title: Maintenance Work Order #2291
summary: A request to service the Storage Room camera recorder at 21:10.
details:
Facilities work order #2291, submitted 17:30 Friday from the Lab 2 desk.

Requested by: REYES, A.
Work: Service check of CCTV recorder, Storage Room B.
Requested time: 21:10 tonight.
Note: "Timing is important. Recorder must be in service mode by 21:10."

Routed to Communications for remote action.
source: Communications Room copy of the Facilities work order

title: Garage Stairwell Door Log
summary: Card 0331 opened the garage stairwell door after hours.
details:
Reader log for the garage stairwell door, which opens into the ground-floor corridor beside Storage Room B.

21:07  IN  card 0331  (Reyes, A.)

This door is not covered by the lobby turnstile or the lobby camera.

title: Garage Barrier Log, Executive Bay
summary: Victor Lang's car left the garage at 20:55.
details:
Exit ticket log for the garage barrier.

20:55  EXIT  permit E-001  (Lang, V.)

No re-entry recorded for permit E-001 that night.

title: Letter to Kessler-Ward Corp.
summary: Lang's carbon copy of a confidential letter about the sale.
details:
Carbon copy from Lang's outbox, dated Friday 16:12, addressed to Kessler-Ward Corp.

"...I confirm that the Argus-7 will be demonstrated on Monday at 10:00 as agreed. Please treat all discussions of terms as strictly confidential until the board has signed..."

Lang was meeting Kessler-Ward's counsel that evening. He needed the prototype in place for Monday.

title: Modem Dial-In Log
summary: A remote dial-in from Daniel Cho's home line at 21:09.
details:
Modem bank log, Communications Room.

21:09  CONNECT  line 4  (caller ID: residential, Cho D.)
21:10  Command: SET RECORDER 03 SERVICE
21:11  DISCONNECT

Cho later confirmed he was carrying out work order #2291.

title: Garage Barrier Log, Permit A-117
summary: Alex Reyes's car left the garage at 21:44.
details:
Exit ticket log and barrier-camera still.

21:44  EXIT  permit A-117  (Reyes, A.)

The barrier-camera still shows the driver alone, and a dark canvas duffel bag on the passenger seat. The bag looks noticeably fuller than it did in the lobby still.
source: Garage barrier ticket roll and camera

title: Lobby Desk Pressure-Mat Report
summary: The night desk was unattended from 21:05 to 21:25.
details:
Printout from the pressure mat under the night guard's chair.

21:05  CHAIR EMPTY
21:25  CHAIR OCCUPIED

The desk was unmanned for twenty minutes. No entry was made in the shift log for that period.

title: Fingerprint Report
summary: Prints on the case: Voss's, and a fresh partial that matches Reyes.
details:
Latent print examination of the Argus-7 case.

- Multiple prints matching Dr. M. Voss (expected: she handles the unit daily).
- One clear, fresh partial print on the inside latch, matching A. Reyes. Reyes's last logged handling of the case was Thursday afternoon, but the print sits over a smear consistent with a glove.

No other prints of value.

title: Keycard Access
summary: Card 0331 opened Storage Room B at 21:14.
details:
Card reader log for Storage Room B.

21:14  OPEN  card 0331  (Reyes, A.)
21:19  CLOSE

No other card was used on this door between 18:00 Friday and 07:30 Saturday.

title: Loan Default Notice
summary: Reyes owes $38,500 with a deadline of Monday 12 March.
details:
Final notice from Ridgeway Savings & Loan, dated Monday 5 March, addressed to A. Reyes.

"Failure to remit the outstanding balance of $38,500 by close of business Monday 12 March will result in foreclosure on the collateralised property."

Found in Reyes's locker at Halden.

title: Telephone Company Call Records
summary: Five calls from Reyes's home number to a Kessler-Ward line.
details:
Call detail records from the telephone company for Reyes's home number, 26 Feb to 8 March.

Five calls to (555) 0147, the business development line of Kessler-Ward Corp., totalling 41 minutes. Two calls were made after 22:00.

title: Voss's Lab Notebook
summary: Voss knew about Kessler-Ward and opposed the sale.
details:
Pages from Dr. Voss's personal notebook.

6 March: "Lang wants to hand the Argus-7 to Kessler-Ward. I would smash it first. They will strip it for parts and bury it."

The notebook shows Voss knew about the Kessler-Ward negotiations, contradicting her claim to investigators that she had "never heard of" the company.

title: Switchboard Message Slip
summary: A hospital called the switchboard for Nina Okafor at 21:04.
details:
Handwritten message slip from the switchboard log.

21:04  For: OKAFOR, N.
From: St. Mary's Hospital Emergency
Message: "Your son has been admitted with a fever. Please call back."

The hospital confirms the call-back at 21:06, lasting eighteen minutes.
